additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Thanks for sending that through and organising it.
As mentioned during our call, I unfortunately cant see a reboot message being sent/received from the charger on OCPP.
I do see the OCPP server going offline and then the charger reconnecting with the bootnotification, but no reboot message which we would normally see come through.
Are you able to check with Meridian if they can do a hard reboot on the charger?
Additionally, we aren’t seeing the power converters do any grouping, but we believe the estop is still engaged?
Is it possible to see what the behaviour is like with the estop unpressed?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
